page.overview:
What is Attack on Adelphi?

During the High Republic Era, the Nihil marauders attacked Adelphi. The Nihil struck without warning and the Jedi Order was unable to arrive in time to stop them. Three hours after the attack Jedi Master Torban Buck asked a group of Jedi Initiates to watch over a group of children who had been separated from their caregivers. The Initiates decided to take the children to a theater where they watched the holofilm Socorro Jayme and the Starcave of Sharu.

The attack on Adelphi was first mentioned in "Three Younglings & the Snackfrog of Doom," a story included in the comic The High Republic Adventures Phase III Annual, which was published by Dark Horse Comics as part of the Star Wars: The High Republic multimedia project's Phase III. The story was written by Charles Soule and Rosemary Soule.
